# co-maintainer

> co-maintainer learns a GitHub repository from its code, pull requests, and history, then reviews pull requests and local changes against that knowledge.

- [Quickstart](https://co-maintainer.com/docs/getting-started.md)

- [Sync](https://co-maintainer.com/docs/sync.md)
- [View guides](https://co-maintainer.com/docs/view.md)
